preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The length of the codes is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The values of x and y are between 0 and n inclusive, with x not exceeding y.
Each color in Bob's guess is between 1 and n+1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' to indicate the existence of a possible secret code.
If 'YES' is output, the next line must contain n integers representing Alice's secret code.

postconditions.expression: x and y must match the conditions
postconditions.description: The output code must satisfy the given values of x and y, where x is the number of matching indices and y is the size of the multiset intersection.

invariants.description: The total length of all codes across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.
